verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a fair question for a search platform with a cloud dashboard, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no assistant inside the product. The native MCP server lets external AI clients drive Meilisearch through natural-language prompts. Conversational search is an API capability developers build into their own apps. Neither is a built-in assistant the user can delegate tasks to, so both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
